notes: All eight listed snapshot files were read; all are Common Crawl captures (sourceUrl = the index lookup address in each file footer; sourceDate = capture-timestamp date). No live copies were listed for this chunk. Purdue (3 pages): single-person "Distinguished PhD Alum" profiles giving only the then-current title and institution (Darden; UTDallas) with no graduation year or department. The sidebar "Graduate profiles 2013/2012" name lists on these pages are Krannert alumni-association profile links with no degree stated and were not recorded as doctoral graduates. Case Western DM alumni page: the 2015 capture shows the "Alumni Roster — Class of 2015" and the 2016 capture the "Class of 2016" roster (yearMeaning class-of). Degree is copied from the suffix after each name (DM, PhD, or null when none). Twelve names appear in both rosters, mostly without a degree or dissertation in 2015 and with PhD plus a dissertation in 2016 (Baah, Babu, Kendall, Ladd, McGuire, Murphy, Oet, Olson, Sanger, Stevens; Holloway appears in both without a degree), so the 2015 roster seems to include people who had not yet completed; the integrator should prefer the later snapshot for those names. Destination combines the employer and city as printed; entries with only a city (Lori D. Kendall) have destination null and the location in note. Page typos kept as written (Stragegic, Detriot, od, SanFrancisco, Emperical, Redesigining). Kent State: the College of Business Administration "PhD Alumni" page lists all business departments (MIS, Finance, Marketing and Entrepreneurship, Accounting), not only operations; each line reads "Ph.D., Fall YYYY", recorded as listedYear with yearMeaning graduation (degree term; integrator may wish to treat as degree date rather than a separately stated graduation statement). Personal e-mail addresses on the page were deliberately omitted. MIT Sloan OM theses page: both captures list the same four theses (identical content), recorded once per snapshot with the thesis date year as listedYear (yearMeaning graduation; the page gives thesis dates, not a separate graduation statement) and the thesis title and research advisor in note. The page itself says it lists only "some" theses. "Hari Abyhankar" is kept as spelled.
